title: The teacher born in George Washington's time remembers a Native American friend
place_text: Range Two, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: remember the teacher in 1965 who had been born when George Washington was born

plain: Charles Hall says that in 1965, at a spot called Range Two in Nevada's Indian Springs Valley, a tall white being he calls the Teacher, who he says "had been born when George Washington was born", told him about a Native American friend it remembered from long ago. Hall tells Michels this from his own memory of what he describes as three years spent with tall white aliens near Area 51, a secret Air Force site in Nevada; if true, these beings live for centuries and have been on Earth since before America was a country.
